verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a free Lite plan for any single user with 'essential smart time blocking features' [reclaim-docs-16]. It also documents Scheduling Links as a booking feature [reclaim-docs-49], but nothing in the pack says those links are included in the free tier or how limited they are. missing for 10: explicit evidence that Scheduling Links are included in the free Lite plan, any limits on free-tier links (number, duration, branding), independent or hands-on confirmation of free-tier booking use.
